summary: The current implementation satisfies the saved P1 profile-defined app endpoints plan: profile parsing validates app_endpoints with service, port, URL path, health metadata, visibility normalization, duplicate/env-name detection, service references, and secret-free paths; endpoint resolution generates deterministic internal URLs and agent/validation environment variables while omitting console/internal endpoints from agent env; validation identity includes endpoint declarations and generated env digests; workspace detail and runtime responses expose sanitized non-internal endpoint metadata without runtime env values, secret refs, credentials, or query strings; console types and runtime UI consume the endpoint shape without browser-clickable links. Required validation passed: targeted profile/runtime/service/API pytest suites, console typecheck, ruff, mypy, full unit suite, console lint, console build, and the 99% coverage gate at 99.05%.
